generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately as per applicable law
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period at contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by authority while granting is extension of time

All the work as Maintained in the Bill of Quantity (BOQ) are including lead and lift charges loading and unloading charges labor charges all incidental charges hire charges of all machinery and equipment required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per standard technical specification and directions of Engineer in charge of the work

The tenderer shall accept all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and / or liable for those cost. The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
Materials like bitumen,steel,cement etc.,required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Ramanagara Spl. Division, Ramanagara during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday , the next working day will be considered
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
Tenderer who qualifies in the technical bid only those tenderers financial bid will be opened
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Cat-I/ Cat-II(A) & Other reserved category as prescribed in the tender documents.

Bidders should be a domicile of Karnataka for not less than 10 years prior to the last date of submission of tenders and shall ensure upload of relevant valid document certifying his /her domicile status issued by the competent authority failure to upload the Domicile certificate will lead to rejection of TENDER
Tenderers should upload valid PWD registration license copy is mandatory
Tenderers registered under class III may tender for works within the districts of the PWD circles wherein they are registered, otherwise tender shall be rejected
Tenderers registered under class IV may tender for works within the districts or within the division whichever is applicable, where they are registered, otherwise tender shall be rejected

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates

Providing  and  laying  in  Cement  Concrete    for  all  Basement  &  surface  level works,  return  walls,  retaining  walls,  sunken  floors  etc.  The    granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all   other   appurtenances    required to complete the work as per technical  specifications. - M 25   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures

Providing   weep   holes   in   Brick   masonry/Plain/   Reinforced concrete  abutment,  wing  wall/  return  wall  with  100  mm  dia AC pipe, extending through the full width of the structure with slope of 1V :20H towards drawing foce. Complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2706 & 2200
